main_text.l: "storum jus dicere & justitiam administrare,

"stretur. Vice versa non debet Magistratus

"curare debet, ut non desint qui illis muneri-
"bus defungantur.

ordinis: insuper æquam & eandem (quæ est J-

quæ sacerdotibus attributa erat, non quidem quâ

quâ principibus populi, liberis capitibus, juris
Divini & humani Imprimis consultis, &
quibus cum sint familia, fundi, reditus, jus

regimine cum reipublicæ tum maximè

page.notes: The Greek word in the fourth-last line is partly unclear and is marked as printed; "nostep" contains a Cyrillic-like letter that should read "noster"; the pencil "331" and dots in margins are not printed text. Catchword "Eccle-" appears at the foot right and is hyphenated line continuation.
